purpose: Per-query MHCflurry with-flanks processing scores (x10000, integer-rounded) for every boundary processing query used by edge-costs.tsv.gz, so intended_proc_score_x10000 is re-derivable offline for every edge by summing this table over the edge's reconstructed queries. The offline verifier sums these recorded values and does not run the model.
reproduction: Re-inference during research review with the byte-identical recorded 2.3.0 bundle reproduced all recorded intended_proc_score_x10000 values exactly (max rounded difference 0). This table is corroborated by the recorded edge sums; it is not a new scientific claim.
scope: Recorded model-prediction source, not experimental processing, presentation, safety, or efficacy.
